defects.title: Admin sidebar app name hardcoded — does not use tenant config app_name
defects.root_cause_summary: Sidebar.tsx renders a hardcoded literal 'BilimBaga' instead of reading app_name from the tenant config query. The login page correctly fetches and displays app_name; the sidebar does not.

defects.title: Department Admin cannot log in — RequireAuth race condition redirects to /login after successful API authentication
defects.root_cause_summary: RequireAuth reads getQueryData(['auth', 'accessToken']) synchronously. For users without a prior httpOnly refresh cookie, /auth/refresh returns 401, the cache stays null, and the synchronous guard redirects to /login — even immediately after a successful login mutation sets the cache — because the route change triggers a new synchronous evaluation before the query settles.
defects.routing_action: delegate to Issue Resolution (fix before D-01; D-01 testing is unblocked by this fix because RBAC verification requires dept admin login to work)

grouping_recommendation: Fix D-02 first (blocks RBAC verification for AC#6). D-01 and D-02 have different root causes and different modules; treat as separate Issue Resolution tasks.
